samples.question: Each of the four shelves carries six trains, and a train is a run of square cars standing side by side. Deal one shelf's six trains into two groups, each whole train going into one group or the other; a group's load is its total number of cars. Exactly one shelf can be dealt into two groups of equal load, and the two groups need not hold the same number of trains. Which shelf is it? The shelves are numbered 1 to 4 from the top. Answer with exactly one of: shelf-1, shelf-2, shelf-3, shelf-4.
